spark_open.description: A single quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse grass. The body, head, legs and tail are covered in dense, long, shaggy brown fur that is dark brown on the back, sides and outer legs and lighter creamy-tan on the muzzle, lower jaw, chest and belly. The head is bear-like with a broad muzzle, black nose, small dark eye and slightly closed mouth. Between the ears on the forehead rises a single long, glossy black, sharply pointed horn that curves upward and backward then forward, with a small tooth-like projection on its inner concave edge. The entire dorsal surface from just behind the neck to above the rump is covered by a large, domed, highly glossy dark brown shell with fine longitudinal ridges and a reflective surface, with a smaller shield-like plate overlapping it at the front near the neck and a row of small oval perforations along its lower edge. The animal stands on four thick, sturdy legs ending in broad paws with visible dark claws.

meta_spark.description: A large four-legged furry mammal shown in right profile standing on a small patch of ground. The body, head, legs and short stub tail are covered in thick shaggy brown fur like a bear, with a lighter tan muzzle and underbelly, small rounded ears, and broad clawed paws. A single long glossy black curved horn with a small prong rises from the center of the forehead and arches forward. The entire back from behind the shoulders to the rump is covered by a large glossy dark brown domed shell with lengthwise ridges and a row of small oval holes along its lower edge, like a beetle's elytra.
